notes.title: TACTICAL ASSAULT v0.8.8 - WAR CORRESPONDENT UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey all,

[b]TLDR: UPDATE AND PLAY Tactical Assault VR[/b]

I'm super excited to finally release the new Incoming Storm Remastered mission and LIV Creator Kit!

[h2]Incoming Storm Remastered[/h2]
The original Incoming Storm was the very first mission I designed almost 3 years ago! Whew! Time flies. [i]Clearly, my Da'Vincian art skills were too much for the world to handle *sarcasm*[/i]. In collaboration with [b]Patient 8 games[/b], the map has been completely revamped with a ton of new design updates and upgrades. There's more verticality, more ladders, more enemies, more atmosphere and more...well, you get the point. Just play it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/bdb75e7eacb9f55c3122b466001e267ae673d373.gif[/img]

[h2]LIV Creator Kit:[/h2]
In addition to the remastered map, both PCVR [b]AND[/b] Stand-Alone users can take advantage of the newly integrated [url=https://www.liv.tv/lck-creator-kit]LIV Creator Kit[/url]! With the new LIV Creator Kit, stand alone users now have the ability to capture external camera views, previously only available to PCVR users.[i] LIV is a team made up of a bunch of wizards![/i] Everything is handled internally so there's no need to use an external recording app.

Alternatively though, PCVR users still have an extra option to record or stream externally onto their monitor if they so choose ([b]Render To Monitor[/b] in the LIV Creator Kit settings menu).

Capture your gameplay runs, review your performance or make your own films! There's plenty of variety and possibilities for you and your team.

Need more explanation into TAVR's LIV Creator Kit integration? Just watch this tutorial video by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@VirtualRealityOasis]Virtual Reality Oasis[/url]:
[previewyoutube=l5CA5Kj5G2E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Stricter Punishments for Team-Killing/Griefing:[/h2]
Griefing/Team-Killing has been a major problem with the Tactical Assault VR community. It is quite unfortunate to see a game you've poured your heart and soul into turn into a troll-fest.

With that said, Auto-Kick Team-Killers is enabled in ALL [b]public[/b] lobbies. With AKTK OFF, the amount of team-kills allowed is increased but not entirely removed. Private rooms are unaffected. To combat constant griefing, a multiplayer BAN system has been implemented for players who take joy in making others miserable. All team-kills are tallied. Breaking the rules can and will result in a 12-hour ban from multiplayer.

[i]To reiterate, these changes affect PUBLIC lobbies.[/i]

[h2]Improved Bullet Penetration[/h2]
Yes, it was bugged. There I fixed it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/93e29b74eba10732dda8e22a67b573ff4c2d0a78.gif[/img]

[h2]PCVR EXCLUSIVE - Real-time Shadows:[/h2]
Want better lighting/graphics? Well I got something for ya'!

Real-time shadows (PCVR ONLY)! Bring your Nvidia GT710 to its boiling point by enabling real-time shadows [i](just kidding, don't use a Nvidia GT710. In fact, just let it go already, geez).[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/5840086d2fd8a51e0e04c364d76f40fec6370998.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/fdc011218f93007eb8740c8dc236f7cf12945a7c.gif[/img]

[h2]Added Lore/Story to Mission Briefings:[/h2]
Tactical Assault VR has always had a more open-ended, blank-slate sandbox approach so a story wasn't originally in my cards. But many of you still prefer that a game comes with a story, background, characters and lore. In collaboration with [b]Canto[/b] (discord community member) TAVR now has that! See an overview of each mission in the Singleplayer mission briefing menu. Or let [b]Jorin[/b]'s (discord community member) deep ahh voice read it for you. The future of TAVR's story is currently being expanded on [i](along with some future content)[/i] and we can't wait to have that fully fleshed out for you all.

----------------------------------------

[b]HUGE[/b] Thank you to our Discord Community private play-testers for providing their time in helping me tighten up the Incoming Storm Remaster and LIV Creator Kit.
[i]Fun fact: The graffiti art throughout the Incoming Storm Remaster was designed by our private play-testers! Can you find them all?[/i]

[b]Full list of Update Notes:[/b]

Tactical Assault VR v0.8.8

[b]Additions:[/b]
• Incoming Storm REMASTER
• (PCVR) LCK now replaces the previous camera recording method on PCVR. By default, the cameras no longer render on your monitor (as a performance saving measure). You must enable the "Render To Monitor" option for desktop capture. Otherwise, all recording is handled internally through LIV Creator Kit. Saved PCVR recordings will be found in your "Installation Directory > Tactical Assault VR Recordings" directory.
• Added lore/story overview for each mission (written by Canto)
• Added Mission Brief Voice Overs in Singleplayer mission select (Voice overs by Jorin)
• Added TOC Voice Overs for exfil (Voice overs by Jorin)

[b]Griefing/Team Killing:[/b]
• Changed: To combat griefing-only lobbies, public rooms are automatically closed if the host has 4+ team kills regardless of the AKTK setting. Private rooms are unaffected by this change

[b]Voice-Over Commands/Enemy Surrendering Tips:[/b]
Voice-Over commands only work with the Enemy Surrendering modifier ON. Enemies can decide to hold their position and contemplate their next decision.

[u]Voice-Over Commands:[/u]
If an enemy is contemplating, holding JOYSTICK-UP will continually shout "Drop Your Weapon!" voice-over commands to the enemy and lower their morale. The lower their morale, the more likely they will surrender. Some enemies are committed to the cause so not all enemies will surrender, unless forced.

[u]Surrendering:[/u]
Enemies can also be forced to surrender or have their morale heavily decreased through less-lethal means such as Flashbangs, Beanbag Shotgun or melee hits. It is also possible to knock an enemy out with a Beanbag Shotgun headshot. The enemy can be detained while in the downed-state.

[u]Detaining:[/u]
When an enemy surrenders with their hands up, continue shouting commands to have the enemy drop to their knees. Arresting a standing enemy can also be performed but will take more time to secure.

[u]Securing:[/u]
Grab a surrendering enemy by their wrists and hold their wrists until the zip ties are automatically placed. After some time, a confirmation by Operations Command will acknowledge the arrest and the enemy will disappear. An "Enemies Secured" point will be added to the team score.

[h1]Workaround #1: Keep using Virtual Desktop[/h1]

1. Within your Steam Library, under Tactical Assault VR's Manage Button [i](the gear icon)[/i] select [b]Properties...[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/5911b3ce41e022b412f5d066a37632d838ecc552.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/1377bbe6bfbd9edaa8d3bc9c91048c39133656c6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/aa86c926e6d6f12f731c9ca41276cc374b9778d0.png[/img]

4. [b]Restart SteamVR[/b] and within the SteamVR Settings, confirm that your Current OpenXR Runtime displays [b]VirtualDesktopXR (Bundled)[/b]

5. [b]Launch Tactical Assault VR[/b]

notes.notes:
It's here!
[previewyoutube=NCNI4nOwxXM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Operation: Breaking Whisper[/h1]
[i]The captured operatives have been found on a remote island off the coast of Guam. Before our drone was shot down, intel showed that the island was being used to store the enemy's weapons.

Mission Objectives:
• Recover the Crashed Drone Intel
• Extract the Drone Intel
• Rescue and Secure all Hostages
• Search for and Destroy the Weapons Cache
• EXFILTRATE[/i]

What was originally designed as the first iteration of Trident Lightning (TL) has been repurposed and redesigned as an entirely new mission.

Guys, I could not get the original TL island + mansion to run on stand-alone headsets. It was too taxing on stand-alone hardware. So the island was scrapped entirely and we were left with the current TL road and mansion. Then Hammer Fire was released and I was set to push the full TL island on PCVR only. [b]But that sucked! Everyone agreed that idea sucked![/b] Stand-alone players shouldn't be left behind! So they kicked me back down into my hole, chained me up, lowered me some scraps and I got to work.

Hundreds of pen jabs to my back later...

Thanks to some internal suggestions from [b]2080 Games[/b] and with the help of our private group of Discord community testers, the entire island was redesigned, revamped, optimized, and can now be played by [b]everybody![/b]

I said this about Hammer Fire, but here we are again. Breaking Whisper boasts the highest enemy count of any mission in the game and is the most-action-packed mission, yet!
[h1]Coop Shootout Mode:[/h1]
Turn your brain off and take on waves of enemies with your friends!
Finally, as promised a very long time ago, Shootout mode is now available in multiplayer Coop! Up to 6 players on stand-alone and 8 players on PCVR can light up the streets of TAVR. There's only one map for now, the original Urban street map. But more shootout maps are planned to be released in future updates.
[h1]SHOTGUNS:[/h1]
[b]"When shotguns?!"[/b]
Here! There you go. Now stop asking!
[i](Modeled by Puddle_NL)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/f633a07f21ec9889096fc3fe971f997fdce2a6d3.png[/img]

A lot of you hated that enemy ai could deflect bullets with their weapons which resulted in frustrating engagements. Welp, that feature has been removed. The result though was that the game got too easy. To balance that out, enemy reaction time and accuracy have been increased. Oh, and they pie around corners now, too. Good luck.

Hostages will now become enemy targets after you've triggered them to follow. Please, protect Eduardo at all cost! He's a sensitive fella with lowered health. Oh, and maybe you can LARP as his brother, Antonio, too (found within Avatar Customization).
[h1]Map Drawing:[/h1]
Bring out your inner Picasso with the brand-new map drawing feature! Found in the Main Menu and Training Lobby briefing room. Just, please, no cucumbers and cherrys...please. Oh no....
[i](Engineered by Justin P. Barnett)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/cfc3f830cdf1cc3b74ab8b383cd3472e3b295f66.png[/img]

[h3][b]Operation: HAMMER FIRE[/b][/h3]
The uploaded data along with intel gathered from various ground sources has allowed us to pinpoint the exact location of the enemy leader. Located within a mountainous region is a compound where the enemy leader resides. Our first attempt to take him down has failed.

Mission:
• Destroy the downed helicopter by planting C4 onto it
• Eliminate the HVT (High-Value Target)
• Exfiltrate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730144/342e0687bb6b964ffd0539e9e7fe71dc2ca4ca63.jpg[/img]

At long last, it's finally here! The Compound mission, titled "[b]Hammer Fire[/b]", is loosely based on a real-life mission that took place in Abbottabad, Pakistan in 2011.

Operators will have to make their way through a steep-inclined, treacherously large town and push towards the compound where the HVT resides. You'll find yourself transitioning from large, open space to claustrophobia-inducing, shoulder-to-shoulder walls.

Destroy the remains of the downed helicopter and carefully place your shot when taking down the HVT.

Hammer Fire boasts the highest enemy count between all previous missions and has the most intense fire-fights you'll experience in virtual reality.
